rationale.verdict: Discovery incomplete due to absence of deployed contract addresses. Multiple accessible sources (website, docs, DeFiLlama) confirm Echo Lending exists and is operational on Aptos with $141M+ TVL, but specific contract addresses on Aptos mainnet could not be extracted from fetched URLs. No GitHub repository or audit documentation was accessible to provide address enumerations. Aptos explorer name-tag searches and read-API calls were not attempted (tools not available via web_fetch for Aptos-specific queries). Marked grade='unknown' per discovery slice protocol.

evidence.shows: Echo Protocol website landing page; confirms Echo Lending component with $220.55M net assets, $22.3M borrowed, 9.16% utilization rate; links to https://lending.echo-protocol.xyz app and https://echo-protocol.gitbook.io docs.

Echo Protocol documentation homepage; table of contents includes protocol architecture, technical architecture, integration docs, app docs for Echo Lending, tokenomics; no deployed addresses page found in accessible TOC.

DeFiLlama protocol page for Echo Lending; reports $141.32M TVL on Aptos, annualized fees $33,416, active loans $375,701; includes link to 'View code on GitHub' but destination not fetched in this run.

Educational article on Echo Protocol; confirms aBTC liquid staking token, lending markets, $878M peak TVL in May 2025, audits mentioned as 'independent third-party audits before deployment' but no specific audit URLs provided.

protocol_metadata.about: Echo Lending is a decentralized lending protocol built natively on Aptos, enabling users to deposit Bitcoin-backed assets (primarily aBTC, a one-to-one Bitcoin-backed liquid staking token) and earn yield. As part of the broader Echo Protocol, it facilitates lending and borrowing of BTC, APT, and stablecoins (zUSDT, zUSDC), with integrated yield strategies and restaking opportunities through Aptos' MoveVM infrastructure.
